# Mikhael Manurung

I am an immunologist and computational biologist at Leiden University Medical Center. I study how environmental exposures, infection history and genetics shape human immune variation and responses to infection and vaccination.

My work combines cytometry and single-cell profiling with computational methods. I also develop open-source tools for interpretable analysis and reproducible research.
